entries.heading: Kafka Intake 장애

conditions.description: Current event POST fails with Kafka unavailable or produce timeout, or Kafka readiness is directly failing. A generic HTTP 503 without endpoint/error details is insufficient. Current successful appends plus healthy Kafka contradict this intake-failure condition.

checks: Kafka Pod readiness and recent logs
topic bootstrap job status and logs
entries.action_boundary: Investigation procedure only. A matching symptom does not authorize restart or topic changes.
verification: event acceptance and downstream persistence checked separately
entries.validation_scope: Indexed repository runbook, not proof of the current cause or a newly validated recovery

entries.heading: PostgreSQL / Pgpool 장애
entries.scope: messaging-app PostgreSQL HA / Pgpool persistence path

conditions.description: Investigation relevance, not a proven request root cause: a current blocking edge or explicit PostgreSQL primary reachability failure warrants DB-path investigation. Queued requests, lag or generic HTTP 503 alone are insufficient. Absent waits and healthy readiness alone do not exclude DB-path problems. The grounded path supplies a bounded code-owned CURRENT constraint; discuss earlier blocking separately as history.

entries.action_boundary: Read-only diagnosis. Sync changes, restarts and primary rollout require separate operator decisions. Preserve local RollingUpdate partition=1.
verification: database readiness and required standby checks
entries.validation_scope: Repository procedure; historical startup-probe evidence covers local standbys only, not primary rollout or general failover

entries.heading: Worker Consumer Lag 증가

conditions.description: Known requests were accepted with 202 but persistence is delayed, supported by valid consumer lag or persistence latency evidence. Invalid/negative lag and an unrelated HTTP error do not establish this condition.

checks: PostgreSQL persistence path when lag persists
entries.action_boundary: Applicable means investigate this symptom. Do not infer insufficient replicas or recommend scaling from lag alone; partition retry may preserve ordering.
verification: consumer lag returns to an observed stable range
entries.validation_scope: Repository investigation procedure; calibrated backlog activation remains a separate deterministic policy
